name: help-article-list
title: Help article list
description: A help centre collection: its title and article count, then articles grouped by section with a one-line summary each.
docs: count defaults to the number of articles and updated is an ISO date. With more than three sections a jump row of anchors appears; give two lists on one page their own idPrefix. contact is your own node for the Can't find it? aside, so say how to reach a person there. Rows carry no dates on purpose. Pass labels to translate the counts and the date, and linkAs={Link} for your router. The aside sits beside its heading once its column is 768px wide, whatever the screen, and your contact node can use container variants such as @3xl: for the same reason.
